mechanism: Deterministically enumerate valid terminal states for complements, ordered strikes, disjoint ranges and complete event sets, then buy only bundles whose minimum payoff exceeds executable cost.
required_gates: immediate executable unwind for every possible incomplete proper subset of filled legs
positive profit after reserving the worst proper-subset unwind loss

execution.orphan_reserve: max(0, -minimum immediate unwind PnL across every non-empty proper subset of filled legs)
execution.qualification: displayed 2x-cost profit minus orphan reserve remains above the frozen capacity floor

provisional: A qualified paper bundle is still non-atomic.
Displayed unwind liquidity is not a guarantee of an acknowledged fill.
